source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 100 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text: SEC. 51P-100.101.LEGISLATIVE HISTORY. PD 100 was established by Ordinance No. 15903, passed by the Dallas City Council on August 9, 1978. Ordinance No. 15903 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51, “Comprehensive General Zoning Ordinance,” of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 15903; 25423)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text: SEC. 51P-100.102.PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE. PD 100 is established on property generally located on the north line of Willow Lane, beginning at a point 897.72 feet east of the east line of Preston Road. The size of PD 100 is approximately 10.99 acres. (Ord. Nos. 15903; 25423)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-100.103.DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.
(a)Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.
(b)Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25423)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-100.104.DEVELOPMENT PLAN. All development shall be in conformance with a site plan (Exhibit 100A) which was approved by the city plan commission and city council. (Ord. Nos. 15903; 25423)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text: SEC. 51P-100.105.USES. Single-family zero lot line detached dwellings, a lake, and common open areas are permitted. (Ord. Nos. 15903; 25423)

sections.title: Density
sections.text: SEC. 51P-100.106.DENSITY. A maximum of 42 dwelling units are permitted. (Ord. Nos. 15903; 25423)

sections.title: Subdivision Plat
sections.text: SEC. 51P-100.107.SUBDIVISION PLAT. Prior to issuance of any building permits, a subdivision plat, as approved by the city plan commission, must be filed for record with the County Clerk. (Ord. Nos. 15903; 25423)

sections.title: Building Setbacks
sections.text: SEC. 51P-100.108.BUILDING SETBACKS. All buildings must be set back as indicated on the approved site plan. No building may be located closer than 10 feet to any dedicated street. Where automobile storage spaces are located in an enclosed structure so as to face upon or be entered directly from a street, no building may be located closer than 20 feet to any dedicated street. A zero side yard is permitted on one side of each individually platted lot as indicated on the approved site plan, with a minimum side yard of five feet for the remaining side yard. A minimum rear yard of five feet must be provided. On Lot 1, Block 23/7460 only, air conditioning units are allowed within the 15-foot side yard setback line along Willow Lane. In addition, air conditioning units are allowed closer than 10 feet apart on the same lot and in the same block. (Ord. Nos. 15903; 25423; 25706)

sections.title: Coverage
sections.text: SEC. 51P-100.109.COVERAGE. Maximum lot coverage is 60 percent of the total lot area. (Ord. Nos. 15903; 25423)

sections.title: Height
sections.text: SEC. 51P-100.110.HEIGHT. No building may exceed 24 feet in height. (Ord. Nos. 15903; 25423)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking
sections.text: SEC. 51P-100.111.OFF-STREET PARKING. A minimum of two off-street parking spaces per dwelling must be provided. (Ord. Nos. 15903; 25423)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text: SEC. 51P-100.112.SIGNS. All signs must comply with the non-business regulations as specified in Chapter 41, "Sign Standards," of the Dallas City Code. (Ord. Nos. 15903; 25423)

sections.title: Street Dedication
sections.text: SEC. 51P-100.113.STREET DEDICATION. All lots must be served by a dedicated street with a minimum right-of-way of 46 feet. (Ord. Nos. 15903; 25423)

sections.title: Screening And Landscaping
sections.text: SEC. 51P-100.114.SCREENING AND LANDSCAPING. Screening must be provided as indicated on the site plan. An eight-foot wood fence with masonry piers must be provided along the west, north, and east property lines, with no openings or breaks permitted. The natural vegetation must be retained along the south property line except in those areas shown on the site plan where removal is necessary for ingress, egress, or vehicular safety. No trees may be cleared from any part of the site unless such clearance has been indicated on the site plan. (Ord. Nos. 15903; 25423)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text: SEC. 51P-100.115.PAVING. All driveways, entrances, and dedicated streets must be constructed to the requirements of the department of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 15903; 25423)

sections.title: Homeowners’ Association
sections.text: SEC. 51P-100.116.HOMEOWNERS’ ASSOCIATION. A homeowners’ association must be created by the developer for the proper care and maintenance of the common area. The instrument creating the homeowners’ association must be approved by the city attorney, submitted to the city plan commission, and filed in the deed records of Dallas County, Texas, prior to the sale of any lot or tract. (Ord. Nos. 15903; 25423)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-100.117.GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.
(a)All development within this PD must be in conformance with all other codes and regulations of the city.
(b)All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications adopted for such purpose to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.
(c)No certificate of occupancy shall be issued by the building official until there has been full compliance with this article in accordance with the requirements of the building for which the certificate is issued, and any applicable provisions of the zoning ordinance and the building codes. (Ord. Nos. 15903; 25423; 26102)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text: SEC. 51P-100.118.ZONING MAP. PD 100 is located on Zoning Map No. D-7. (Ord. 25423)
